in_sanskrit.name: Balbinder
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Brave Binder
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Balbinder एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Balbinder is derived from the Sanskrit words 'bal' meaning strength and 'bindu' meaning drop or mark. It signifies a brave and powerful individual who is strong and his core.
